scenarios.title: Accelerometer DeviceUse
scenarios.description: Launches a DeviceUse trigger background task to listen for accelerometer data. Displays the number of data samples received by the background task.

controls.name: ScenarioEnableButton
controls.label: Enable
controls.expected: Registers the accelerometer DeviceUse background task; disables Enable, enables Disable when a sensor is present.

controls.name: ScenarioDisableButton
controls.label: Disable
controls.expected: Unregisters the background task; re-enables Enable, disables Disable.

outputs.name: StatusBlock
outputs.expected: Status message, e.g. 'No accelerometer found' when no sensor hardware is present.

scenarios.hardwareNote: Requires a physical accelerometer. On hardware-less machines both UWP and WinUI display 'No accelerometer found' and the Enable/Disable actions produce no sample data.
